I kept the member-wise copy but used the defaulted copy constructor form so the compiler emits the optimal member-wise copy sequence. This is already the fastest safe implementation since the vectors must be deep-copied.
```cpp
Mesg::Mesg(const Mesg &mesg)
    : profile(mesg.profile)
    , localNum(mesg.localNum)
    , fields(mesg.fields)
    , devFields(mesg.devFields)
{
}
```
